$comment: The real app screens the site shows (BRIEF §6). Each is the app's golden <golden>_<theme>_<device>.png at `ref`, never redrawn. Bump `ref` to the app's release tag when it ships, then `pnpm sync:screens`.

alt.en: Sogda's Today screen: a ring showing 12 of 20 cards done, about 6 minutes left, then today's plan: revise 10 words, 7 new words, a backlog of 14, 3 practice sentences and the grammar topic of the week.
Sogda's Today screen on a tablet: the day's progress ring and today's plan side by side.
A revision card showing the German word “die Rechnung” with a speaker button, before its meaning is revealed.
The back of the card for “die Rechnung”: the meaning “bill, invoice” in English and Bangla, two example sentences, and the Again, Hard, Good and Easy ratings with their next intervals.
Grammar practice on Konjunktiv II: pick the right form for “… Sie mir bitte das Formular schicken?”, with the answer “Könnten” marked correct and the rule explained.
A practice sentence, “Der Vermieter hat die Nebenkosten für nächstes Jahr erhöht.”, with a play button, its English translation, and the choices Understood, Partly and Not yet.
The day complete screen, “Tag geschafft!”, with confetti: 17 words in 12 minutes, a 13 day streak, and tomorrow's plan.
An article quiz: pick der, die or das for the word “Vermieter”.
A listening quiz: play the word, then type what you hear, with keys for ä, ö, ü and ß.
The listening section of a mock exam, with a timer, a play button with 3 plays left, and an answer field.
A mock exam result: passed with 77 %, 37 of 48 points, and a score for each section: vocabulary, reverse, articles, word forms, gap fill, grammar, listening, writing and speaking.
The course overview: the steps A1.1 and A1.2 passed, A2.1 current with 11 cards left today, and the later steps still locked.
Step A2.1: 540 words and 10 grammar topics, with the step's words listed with their articles, meanings and status.
The progress screen: cards per day this week, retention against its target, words per step, study time, reviews and the streak.
The word “die Straße”: its meaning in English and Bangla, examples with audio, related words, and links to Duden, DWDS and Wiktionary.
Comparing near-synonyms side by side, “der Grund” and “die Ursache”: meaning, register, the words they go with, an example, and when to use each.
Searching for “strase”: the exact match “die Straße” despite the typo, words starting with it, similar words, and example sentences.
The placement check, question 1 of 20: what does “die Küche” mean? Four answers to choose from.
The welcome screen: “Learn German, one clear day at a time”, works fully offline with no account, 12 steps from A1.1 to C2.2, and your progress stays on your phone.
The revision card for “die Rechnung” with text at 200 %: every line still fits, the long word breaking between syllables.
